tooltips.JLift: H-K lightness offset in points at the gray end of this tonal row. The offset tapers with saturation.
tooltips.JGamma: Bend this tonal row's lightness response around the saturation pivot. Negative values lower the response below the pivot and raise it above.
tooltips.JGain: Scale this tonal row's lifted and bent lightness response in stops. With Lift and Gamma centered, positive Gain brightens saturated colors.
tooltips.CLift: Chroma gain in stops near gray. The effect tapers toward vivid colors. Exact gray stays neutral.
tooltips.CGamma: Bend this tonal row's chroma response around the saturation pivot. Negative values reduce muted chroma and increase vivid chroma.
tooltips.CGain: Multiply chroma in this tonal row by a gain in stops. One stop requests twice the chroma before H-K repair.
tooltips.saturationPivot: Set the C/|J_A| ratio at which both Gamma curves cross their neutral response. The same pivot applies to all four tonal rows.

tooltips.JLift: 此色调区在中性灰端的 H-K 明度偏移量，以明度点计。偏移随饱和度升高而减弱。
tooltips.JGamma: 绕饱和度枢轴弯曲此色调区的明度响应。负值降低枢轴以下的响应，提高枢轴以上的响应。
tooltips.JGain: 以档为单位缩放此色调区经提升和伽马调整后的明度响应。提升和伽马归零时，正增益提亮高饱和度颜色。
tooltips.CLift: 接近中性灰处的彩度增益，以档计。效果随饱和度升高而减弱。纯中性灰保持中性。
tooltips.CGamma: 绕饱和度枢轴弯曲此色调区的彩度响应。负值降低低饱和度颜色的彩度，提高高饱和度颜色的彩度。
tooltips.CGain: 以档为单位缩放此色调区的彩度。增加一档时，H-K 修正前的目标彩度翻倍。
tooltips.saturationPivot: 设定明度和彩度伽马曲线无偏移时的 C/|J_A| 比值。四个色调区共用此枢轴。
